text.p: These are the leading stories in the Tunisian press on Friday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- President Zine al-Abidine Ben Ali received Belgium's Foreign Affairs Minister Erik Derycke on Thursday.
- Ramadan starts on Friday in Tunisia.

- British Minister of State at the Foreign and Commonwealth Office Jeremy Hanley discussed with Tunisian Foreign Affairs Minister Habib Ben Yahia Tunisia's participation at an Euro-Mediterranean investment forum in London next March.
- Tunisian-Mauritanian talks on bilateral cooperation started on Wednesday with Tunisian Prime Minister Hamed Karoui attending.
